**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
Describe the problem clearly, e.g. "When I try to ... I always have to ..."

**Proposed solution**
Describe the feature/enhancement you'd like and how it should behave.

**Alternative approaches**
Any alternatives you've considered.

**Scope**
Which area does it affect? (e.g. framework/skills, scenarios/programming/coding, scenarios/programming/fullstack, docs, hooks)

**Additional context**
Anything else useful (screenshots, links, examples).
